author: agent-4
note: Nothing here is applied. Every entry is a proposal that needs the supported V1-to-V2 mapping migration, because the change retires a published child id and a V1 record has no alias array to carry it. The proposed_id values are the identities the rows would take if the role label changed; they are computed with the same hash the compiler uses over the layout references, so a reviewer can reproduce them. No source text is quoted in this file.

tooling_blocker.finding: A phrase that continues from one source row into the next cannot be joined by the current merge tool unless the earlier source row has a single output row.
tooling_blocker.reason: The merge joins two adjacent rows of the compiled item, and the compiler emits the output rows of one source row consecutively. When the earlier source row has several output rows, the last Arabic or Persian row of that source row and the first row of the next source row are separated by the intervening outputs, and the tool refuses with "Merge requires two adjacent current rows in source order".
tooling_blocker.affected: namaz-ayd-ftr r00007/r00008 and ziyarat-amamyn-askryyn-alyhma r00002/r00003. The r00003/r00004 and r00007/r00008 joins in the same two items are adjacent in the compiled item and fail only on the role labels.
tooling_blocker.reported_to: agent-5, for relay to the coordinator

items.finding: The Persian renderings of the Arabic prayers are published as detached note rows. They are the renderings of the invocation rows in the same source row and should be published as paired recitations.
items.verified: Every Persian row listed under role_corrections is the rendering of an Arabic invocation row in the same source row: r00002 has one Arabic invocation row and one Persian rendering row, and r00005 to r00011 have three or two Arabic invocation rows followed by the same number of Persian rendering rows. The r00002 pair is 179 Arabic code points against 141 Persian code points, which is the width difference of two languages for one passage.
items.blocker: The tool refuses the pairing merge with "Merge requires matching reviewed row kinds": the Arabic row is a recitation and the Persian row is a note. Correcting the role changes the row identity, because a split row id is a hash of its source row, its language slots and its role label. The published id therefore stops resolving, and a V1 record has no alias array to carry it. On a V2 or V3 record the same revision is refused outright with "revision would orphan a previously published row link; preserve it and request a mapping migration".
